integrity: Symbolic block-matrix proof and exact finite-field checker supplied; no independent verification or publication claimed.
scientific_limitations: The square-zero and line-bundle statements hold over exact corank two only; deeper corank strata not determined. Generic scheme cycle is computed but whole Jacobian primary decomposition is not. Novelty may have classical equivalents. Finite checks are supporting only.
title: A canonical square-zero Jacobian doubling on the corank-two symmetric determinant stratum in characteristic two
